title: Bulk Email Wizard Permission Consistency

items.action: preview bulk email recipients and rendered mail
send bulk email independently of preview access

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing fair email preview and execute permissions are reused.

audit.reason: Existing operation and fair email audit events are preserved.

route_guard.reason: Wizard entry prerequisites are owned by the separate Bulk Email mail-settings/entry contracts; this contract governs preview and send action boundaries.

notes: Bulk email preview has one canonical permission: fair_crm.fair_emails.preview. Bulk email send has one canonical mutation permission: fair_crm.fair_emails.execute. Wizard entry is governed separately by fair_crm.fair_emails.execute together with the mandatory fair_crm.mail_templates.read and fair_crm.email_accounts.read lookup prerequisites. Preview remains an independent optional capability, so absence of preview permission must not block preview-independent Send for a user who otherwise satisfies the wizard-entry prerequisites. SendBulkEmailOperationUseCase independently resolves recipients and validates sender/template/subject and sendable recipients at send time, so the preview result is not a send prerequisite. The /operations/bulk-email/send endpoint internally creates and immediately starts an operation, but that bookkeeping is implementation detail and does not add fair_crm.operations.create or fair_crm.operations.execute as user-facing prerequisites. Generic non-bulk operation create/start actions retain their existing operations permissions.
